statement: IPEDS does not measure income; the Pell share is a common proxy.
glossary or source: Glossary 2025-26: Family income (the income used for the Student Aid Index), and the ACTS component collects family income; IPEDS reports net price by family income for first-time, full-time students awarded Title IV aid
finding: Contradicts: IPEDS does measure family income, for students awarded federal aid (net price and counts by income band).
proposal: Reword, for example: "IPEDS reports family income only for students awarded federal aid (net price by income); for all students, the Pell share is the usual proxy." Not changed: it is a convention, for your decision.
